description: Test class for verifying the OpenAPI documentation endpoints in a Spring Boot application. Uses Spring Boot testing annotations, MockBeans, and REST template to perform smoke tests ensuring the /v3/api-docs endpoint returns a valid OpenAPI JSON response with status 200.

classes.name: OpenApiDocsSmokeTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs smoke testing on the OpenAPI documentation endpoint of a Spring Boot application to verify correct JSON response and status code.

methods.name: v3ApiDocsShouldReturn200
methods.description: Test method that sends a GET request to '/v3/api-docs' and asserts that the response status code is 200, the body is not blank, and it contains the 'openapi' field.
